messages.content:
Risk: Disinformation (ID: atlas-spreading-disinformation)
Description: Generative AI models might be used to intentionally create misleading or false information to deceive or influence a targeted audience.
Concern: Spreading disinformation might affect human's ability to make informed decisions. A model that has this potential must be properly governed.
Policy: Misinformation

Axis: Disinformation (http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#Disinformation)
Roles: object
Subclasses:
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DeepfakeDisinformation: Deepfake Disinformation
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#StateSponsoredPropaganda: State-Sponsored Propaganda
  - http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ConspiracyTheoryPromotion: Conspiracy Theory Promotion
